user.title: Connect to NETIO device
user.description: Enter the connection details for your NETIO device. The JSON API must be enabled on the device (M2M API Protocols > JSON API).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the NETIO device.
data_description.port: Port of the JSON API (default 80, see device web config).
data_description.username: JSON API username configured on the device.
data_description.password: JSON API password configured on the device.
data_description.use_ssl: Connect via HTTPS. NETIO devices use self-signed certificates, so certificate verification is skipped.

dhcp_confirm.description: A NETIO device was found at **{host}**. Enter credentials to complete setup. The JSON API must be enabled on the device.
